results.question: How many severe days (AQI above 400) were there in November 2024?
results.sql: select count(*) as severe_days from v_aqi_daily where aqi > 400 and date between '2024-11-01' and '2024-11-30'

results.question: What was the highest daily AQI ever recorded in the data, and on which date?
results.sql: select date, aqi from v_aqi_daily order by aqi desc limit 1

results.question: What was the average AQI in October 2023?
results.sql: select round(avg(aqi), 1) as avg_aqi from v_aqi_daily where date between '2023-10-01' and '2023-10-31'

results.question: How many upwind fire detections were there in total during the 2022 burning season (October and November)?
results.sql: select sum(fires) as total_fires from v_fires_upwind where date between '2022-10-01' and '2022-11-30'

results.question: Which monitoring station had the highest average AQI in November 2024?
results.sql: select station, round(avg(aqi), 1) as avg_aqi from v_station_daily where date between '2024-11-01' and '2024-11-30' group by station order by avg_aqi desc limit 1

results.question: How many days in each year had a daily AQI above 400?
results.sql: select year(date) as year, count(*) as severe_days from v_aqi_daily where aqi > 400 group by year order by year

results.question: Which week in the 2024 burning season had the highest average AQI?
results.sql: select date_trunc('week', date) as week_start, round(avg(aqi), 1) as avg_aqi from v_aqi_daily where date between '2024-10-01' and '2024-11-30' group by week_start order by avg_aqi desc limit 1

results.question: On which date did upwind fires peak in 2023, and how many were there?
results.sql: select date, fires from v_fires_upwind where year(date) = 2023 order by fires desc limit 1

results.question: What was the average AQI for each month of 2024?
results.sql: select month(date) as month, round(avg(aqi), 1) as avg_aqi from v_aqi_daily where year(date) = 2024 group by month order by month

results.question: What was the longest run of consecutive severe days, and when did it start?
results.sql: with s as (select date, date - cast(row_number() over (order by date) as integer) as grp from v_aqi_daily where aqi > 400) select min(date) as start_date, count(*) as days from s group by grp order by days desc limit 1

results.question: What was the 7-day average AQI ending on 2024-11-15?
results.sql: select round(avg(aqi), 1) as avg_aqi_7d from v_aqi_daily where date between '2024-11-09' and '2024-11-15'

results.question: How many days in October 2025 were in the Very poor band or worse?
results.sql: select count(*) as days from v_aqi_daily where aqi > 300 and date between '2025-10-01' and '2025-10-31'

results.question: What was the average AQI on days after more than 1000 upwind fires?
results.sql: select round(avg(a.aqi), 1) as avg_aqi from v_aqi_daily a join v_fires_upwind f on f.date = a.date - 1 where f.fires > 1000

results.question: On severe days, what was the average share of northwest-wind hours in Delhi?
results.sql: select round(avg(w.nw_frac), 3) as avg_nw_frac from v_aqi_daily a join v_wind_daily w using (date) where a.aqi > 400

results.question: What was the average boundary layer height on severe days versus other days?
results.sql: select a.aqi > 400 as severe, round(avg(w.blh)) as avg_blh from v_aqi_daily a join v_wind_daily w using (date) group by severe order by severe

results.question: On how many days did CAMS put AQI below 400 when the observed AQI was severe?
results.sql: select count(*) as cams_missed from v_aqi_daily a join v_cams_daily c using (date) where a.aqi > 400 and c.aqi_equiv <= 400

results.question: What is the correlation between yesterday's upwind fires and today's AQI in October-November?
results.sql: select round(corr(a.aqi, f.fires), 3) as r from v_aqi_daily a join v_fires_upwind f on f.date = a.date - 1 where month(a.date) in (10, 11)

results.question: Was the 2025 burning season worse or better than 2024 on average AQI?
results.sql: select year(date) as season, round(avg(aqi), 1) as avg_aqi from v_aqi_daily where month(date) in (10, 11) and year(date) in (2024, 2025) group by season order by season

results.question: How did Punjab and Haryana fire counts compare in the 2024 season?
results.sql: select sum(fires_punjab) as punjab, sum(fires_haryana) as haryana from v_fires_upwind where date between '2024-10-01' and '2024-11-30'

results.question: Compare average AQI on weekends and weekdays during October-November.
results.sql: select dayofweek(date) in (0, 6) as weekend, round(avg(aqi), 1) as avg_aqi from v_aqi_daily where month(date) in (10, 11) group by weekend order by weekend

results.question: Which burning season (October-November) since 2019 had the most severe days?
results.sql: select year(date) as season, count(*) as severe_days from v_aqi_daily where month(date) in (10, 11) and aqi > 400 and year(date) >= 2019 group by season order by severe_days desc limit 1

results.question: What was the mean absolute error of the 48-hour forecast in the 2025 season?
results.sql: select round(avg(abs(actual - p50)), 1) as mae from v_forecasts where horizon_h = 48 and season = 2025

results.question: How many severe days did the 48-hour forecast catch with P(severe) of at least 0.5?
results.sql: select count(*) as caught from v_forecasts where horizon_h = 48 and actual > 400 and p_severe >= 0.5

results.question: What share of days fell inside the 24-hour forecast's p10-p90 band?
results.sql: select round(avg(case when actual between p10 and p90 then 1.0 else 0 end), 3) as coverage from v_forecasts where horizon_h = 24

results.question: Which season had the lowest 72-hour forecast error?
results.sql: select season, round(avg(abs(actual - p50)), 1) as mae from v_forecasts where horizon_h = 72 group by season order by mae limit 1
